mapper.select:
SELECT location.*, storeroom.name as storeroom_name FROM tpm_spare_parts_location as location INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM tpm_spare_parts_storeroom WHERE del_flag = '0') as storeroom ON location.storeroom_code = storeroom.code WHERE location.del_flag = '0'
AND location.code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.code},'%')
AND location.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.name},'%')
AND storeroom.code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.storeroomCode},'%')
AND storeroom.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.storeroomName},'%')
ORDER BY location.create_time DESC
